unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 10 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.2 - THEME 8: LIFE IN THE UNIVERSE & THE FUTURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will write a narrative or reflection about one of the following subthemes: the development of space travel technologies, the future of space tourism, or the role of science fiction and imagination. The writing piece should cover advancements, challenges, and visionary ideas. It should include target vocabulary items and phrases from the list provided to them by the teacher. Students are expected to use Conditional 2 and Conditional 3 accurately for hypothetical scenarios. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the universe and the future with its components such as the development of space travel technologies (rockets, spacecrafts); the concept of space tourism and its future; science fiction and imagination'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in the after prep year 10 of an upper secondary school may know what the development of space travel technologies (rockets, spacecrafts); the concept of space tourism and its future; science fiction and imagination mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in another language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in the universe and the future'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 10 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the universe and the future with its components such as the development of space travel technologies (rockets, spacecrafts); the concept of space tourism and its future; science fiction and imagination'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss about the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about space travel technologies (rockets, spacecraft); the concept of space tourism and its future in English by using the target vocabulary. Activity 1: Future of Space Tourism The teacher introduces the activity related to space tourism debate. The teacher prepares two groups: one to discuss in favour of space tourism by emphasising its unique opportunities, potential for advancements, and commercial benefits; the other group to focus on its challenges such as high costs, risks to the crew, and environmental concerns. Each group uses the target vocabulary such as ''booking, lunar, unique, safety, crew, commercial, potential, investment'' in their debate. After the debate, s/he gives feedback on the use of the language including the target vocabulary and creativity. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To create an advertisement on the concept of space tourism and its future in English by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: The teacher introduces the activity to the students and they work in pairs. They write a short advertisement for space tourism. They use the target vocabulary such as ''booking, lunar, unique, safety, crew'' in their sentences and make sentences such as: ''Join our unique lunar excursion! Our experienced crew ensures your safety on this incredible adventure. Now, you will create your own advertisement''. They expand the advertisement with some visuals and present it in class. The teacher listens and gives feedback on the use of language for accuracy and creativity. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
